name: salt-theme
description: Dev-only asset toolchain for the salt parent theme. Runs once in core CI — never on a client site.

scripts.conformance:contract: salt-conformance --platform wordpress --adapter 'php tests/contract-adapter/adapter.php' --not-shipped pricing --acf-snapshot inc/fields/generated/sections.json --fields-options inc/fields/generated/sections.options.json --styles assets/dist/salt.*/salt.css --implementation-version $(sed -n 's/^Version: *//p' style.css) --out tests/contract-adapter/report
